name: Super Sentai Zyuranger
description:
Five young warriors from the ancient civilization of Dinosaur-evolved Humans are awakened in the present day after 170 million years of suspended animation when their sworn enemy, Bandora the Witch, is inadvertently released from her magical container on Planet Nemesis by two astronauts.

The five warriors, the Zyurangers, must summon the power of mechanical-looking deities known as the Guardian Beasts, each modeled after a different prehistoric beast, in order to protect mankind from Bandora's evil forces.

videos.title: The Birth
videos.overview: The first Japanese space shuttle is launched to explore planet Nemesis where the evil Bandora and crew are released. Bandora and her crew immediately set to wreak havoc on Earth. The warriors are captured and must then transform into the mighty Zyuranger heroes.

videos.title: The Revival
videos.overview: Bandora returns the Japanese shuttle and the children within it to Earth, setting up a trap to capture the Zyuranger with a powerful DoraMonster.

videos.title: Fight in the Land of Despair
videos.overview: With their weapons destroyed, the Zyuranger teams heads to the Land of Despair to get legendary weapons, made more difficult when Bandora traps a boy and his mother within.

videos.title: Reawaken, Legendary Weapons
videos.overview: In part two of their challenge with time running short, the Zyuranger must complete their trials and gain the Legendary Weapons before the Land of Despair turns them to stone.

videos.title: Scary Riddles
videos.overview: The Zyuranger fall apart as they fight a strange Dora Monster who punishes those who get its riddles wrong.

videos.title: Arise, Daizyuzin!
videos.overview: After seeing a warning of the potential of Zyuranger's failure, Geki works to prove his leadership qualities to save his team from Dora Sphinx.

videos.title: I Can See! I Can See!
videos.overview: Dan tries to help out a boy who becomes crucial in finding a Dora Monster that can only be seen by children.

videos.title: Terror! Eaten In An Instant
videos.overview: Boi fights to save a happy plump family who are forced to suffer when a Dora Monster steals all their food.

videos.title: Run! Prince of the Eggs
videos.overview: The prince of an ancient kingdom causes chaos when he comes seeking the Zyuranger to help them regain the last dinosaur eggs in existence.

videos.title: Monkeys No More!
videos.overview: The Zyuranger race through Daros Island in order to regain the last dinosaur eggs from the Apelo Tribe before Bandora and Dora Cockatrice can beat them to them.

videos.title: My Master!
videos.overview: A magic lamp found by Tottpatt and Bookback ends up in the hands of children who befriend the genie within even as Bandora targets him for her usage.

videos.title: Papa's a Vampire!?
videos.overview: Dan meets tomboy Michi, who wants her wimpy policeman father to be a hero. Dora Argus makes Michi hallucinate to think her father is legendary vampire, Dracula.

videos.title: Fire! The Golden Arrow
videos.overview: Bandora places Mei under a sleep spell when she becomes crucial for eliminating a Dora Monster that has the ability to keep the witch young.

videos.title: Become Small!
videos.overview: A boy being bullied by adults teams up with an incompetent elf to shrink things into magic bottles for research, including Dan and Boi.

videos.title: Destroy! The Dark Super Sword
videos.overview: Goushi tries to teach courage to a cowardly boy targeted by Bandora for the creation of the ultimate inisible sword.

videos.title: The Great Sneeze Plot
videos.overview: A boy named Isamu gets frustrated once he is rejected from his soccer team. As a result, a Dora Monster disguised as a clown lets Isami start kicking balls filled with sneeze-causing virus towards other people.

videos.title: The Sixth Hero
videos.overview: Gnome's grandson steals a key to reawaken Burai, a legendary hero of the Zyuranger's time whom Barza and Gnome wish not to reawaken.

videos.title: The Hate-Filled Brother's Sword
videos.overview: The Zyuranger discover the truth regarding who Burai is as Bandora approaches DragonRanger to assist her in advancing her own schemes.

videos.title: Female Warrior Scorpion!
videos.overview: Bandora calls upon Grifforzer's wife Lamy to supplement her forces when she pursues two brothers who discovered the last dinosaur eggs.

videos.title: Daizyuzin's Last Day
videos.overview: Bandora tempts the Zyuranger with multiple perils in order for them to summon Daizyujin for her ultimate plan for its destruction.

videos.title: The Guardian Beast's Great Riot
videos.overview: In the wake of Bandora's greatest victory, Burai pulls a startling move that ultimately leads him to a mysterious ally, a warning and the means to summon his own Guardian Beast.

videos.title: Combine! Gouryuzin
videos.overview: A determined Geki faces Burai in a final showdown in order to finally bring an end to the hatred of the Yamato siblings.

videos.title: The Knuckleball of Infatuation
videos.overview: Anyone who swallows DoraPixie's magic baseball is stricken with the curse of blindly falling in love with anything in first sight. Zyurangers struggle to bear DoraPixie as Dan, Boy and Goushi happen to swallow the magic baseball.

videos.title: Hope Springs A-Turtle
videos.overview: Boi becomes trapped in an endless run after he is hit by the motion manipulation abilities of Tottpatt and Bookback's Dora Monster.

videos.title: The Park Where Demons Dwell
videos.overview: Bandora corrupts a new park statue with a Dora Monster that creates poison mouths to hurt children, angering Goushi.

videos.title: Be Careful of Shaved Ice
videos.overview: The Zyuranger become devastated when Dan and Mei adandon them to become punks via Tottopatt's special formula and Bandora's newest Dora Monster starts eating the rest.

videos.title: I Want to Eat Mei
videos.overview: Mei finds the flower of Lyciam, symbol of her tribe. As DoraGuzzler's lethal flowers start to assault people, Mei decides to follow the legend of Princess Yui, who sacrificed her life to save the people of the Lycia tribe.

videos.title: Great Upgrade! Clay Monsters
videos.overview: Dan's new part-time job is inadvertently attacked as Bandora digs for stronger clay to create more powerful DoraMonsters.

videos.title: A Mystery!? The Attacking Beast Knight God
videos.overview: As Bandora continues to torment the Zyuranger with new Dokita clay creations, Geki and Burai are sent to retrieve a new weapon to stop them; even if this means facing a vengeful Guardian Beast!

videos.title: Satan Comes!!
videos.overview: Bandora begins a spell to resummon Great Satan's assistance and the Zyuranger do everything they can to stop its completion.

videos.title: Reborn! The Ultimate God
videos.overview: With Daizyujin and Dragon Caesar being destroyed by the power of SatanFranken, the Zyuranger must undertake a quest that will allow for the ultimate form of Daizyujin to be awakened.

videos.title: Geki! Kill Your Tears
videos.overview: Geki's fear of losing his brother throws off the team, further complicated with Bandora offering to use her latest DoraMonster to revive Burai.

videos.title: Teach Me! The Jewel of Bravery
videos.overview: Dan must teach a girl how to gain courage after she becomes the only means to save a friend and a fairy from a DoraMonster's plot to create the ultimate rainstorm.

videos.title: Stay Alive, Burai!
videos.overview: Burai's impatience of trying to save his remaining life energy leads him to go on a mission to save sisters where he ends up getting captured by Bandora!

videos.title: Ninja Warrior, Boi
videos.overview: Boi is hired as a guard at Tomura Ninja school. DoraNinja goes to the school and tries to steal medicine for longevity, which Tomura is researching.

videos.title: Smash It! The Mirror of Death
videos.overview: A boy named Tadashi finds a map of what he believes to be directions to hidden treasure. Hidden is actually the "Mirror of Havoc", a horrifying mirror which brings immediate death to anyone who looks into it. Zyurangers and Bandora race against each other to find the mirror.

videos.title: A Dinosaur is Born
videos.overview: When children find washed-ashore dinosaur eggs, the Zyuranger scramble to protect them from Bandora's desire to destroy them.

videos.title: Princess Mei's Seven Metamorphoses!!
videos.overview: Lammy nurtures the larva of DoraSilkis with children's souls. Mei tries to counterattack with her kaleidoscopic disguise.

videos.title: A Subterranean Beast's Tears
videos.overview: An earthquake brings an underground monster, Goda to the surface. Despite its monstrous looks, Goda has a gentle heart. Bandora abuses Goda's power to defeat the Zyuranger group.

videos.title: Burai's Deathly Departure
videos.overview: Hearing a warning from Clotho regarding Burai's remaining time left, the Zyuranger desperately search for a way to save him as Bandora sets a plan in motion to hasten DragonRanger's death.

videos.title: Blaze, Burai!!
videos.overview: Bandora uses a fake Dragon Caesar to draw out Burai from the Lapseless Room, allowing her the means to destroy it even as Burai becomes worried about another who is about to die.

videos.title: Burai Dies!
videos.overview: With Kouta dying from being hurt in the DoraMimic attack, Burai faces the giant together in DragonCaesar to avenge him, even with time finally running out before his passing.

videos.title: Live Again, Zyusouken!
videos.overview: After the loss of Burai, grief-stricken Dragon Caesar has lost its soul. Bandora casts spell on Dragon Caesar to hamper its moves while Geki overcomes his sorrow and tries to bring back Dragon Caesar's spirit.

videos.title: Japan's Best Swordswoman
videos.overview: Goushi meets Sayaka, a Kendo woman. Sayaka's talent draws Bandora's attention and DoraChimera takes over Sayaka's body and assaults Goushi.

videos.title: The Foolish Boy
videos.overview: An impish boy, Kouchi, rebels on people who thoughtlessly pollute the river. DoraUnicorn approaches Kouichi and synchronize their senses to prevent the Zyurangers from attacking the monster.

videos.title: Presenting the Vicious Squadron
videos.overview: People begin to lose faith in the Zyurangers when DoraMirage creates malevolent impostors of the team, manipulating the media and spreading their bad reputations.

videos.title: Break in! The Final Deciding Battle
videos.overview: An earthquake and the arrival of a mysterious boy herald the beginning of Great Satan's return to Earth and the start of its final battle with God!

videos.title: The Son from the Darkness
videos.overview: The Zyuranger struggle to deal with Kai and DoraTalos, made further difficult with a decision by King Brachion and the revelation regarding who Bandora and her son really are.

videos.title: The Gods Lost!!
videos.overview: Bandora and Great Satan successfully eliminate all of the Guardians, removing all of the Zyuranger's hopes until they get assistance from a great ally.

videos.title: Long Live The Dinosaurs!!
videos.overview: The Zyuranger make a last-ditch effort to save the Guardian Beasts so they can take down Great Satan and finally bring an end to Bandora's reign of terror!
